Package org.tweetyproject.logics.cl.kappa

Class KappaMin

java.lang.Object
org.tweetyproject.logics.cl.kappa.KappaMin
All Implemented Interfaces:
KappaTerm
public class KappaMin extends Object implements KappaTerm
This class represents a minimum, its elements are KappaTerm instances although in c-representation this are sums of Kappas KappaSum. If it is empty it is evaluated to zero.
